# FROZEN pre-cure shape of a per-file capture cap: a large source read, cut at
# the per-file bound, and stored in a row whose consumer never learned the
# value was short. The notice this shape printed went to a log the consumer
# did not read, so the WRITTEN value carried no trace of the loss.
PER_FILE_CAP = 40000


def capture(path, rows):
    with open(path, encoding="utf-8") as fh:
        text = fh.read()
    row = {"path": path, "source": text[:PER_FILE_CAP]}
    rows.append(row)
    return rows
